messages:
customer_ops: FYI, Zenith (dedicated pool: zenith-prod-us) just hit a token-per-second SLO violation window — seeing lots of 429s and high tail latency. Started 2025-11-05 10:30 UTC. They reported burst credits depleted in under 800ms for a short fanout spike (~250 parallel small completions). CC @support_julie

support_julie: Ack — can you drop org id + route + model? Any recent config changes or key rotations?

customer_ops: org=zenith-inc, route=/v1/complete, model=gpt-open-15b-quant, no key rotation. Traffic pattern: many clients fan-out 10x after batch job completes. Error payload from client:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "code": 429,
  "detail": "burst credits exhausted"
}
```
Also saw a few 502s proxied during the same window.

support_julie: Thanks. Punting to SRE for admission control and burst accounting triage. @sre_cheng can you take a look? Any quick mitigations (headroom, fallback)?

sre_cheng: On it. First pass: are their Dedicated pool autoscale settings at conservative headroom? If headroom too small, single spike will eat credits and drop admissions instead of autoscaling. Do we have headroom and burst_credit config for zenith-prod-us?

customer_ops: Their dedicated config: min_replicas=4, max_replicas=12, burst_credits=5000, autoscale_cooldown=30s. They expected autoscale to kick in, but credits dropped before new replicas warmed.

sre_cheng: That matches a race: admission checks decrement credits atomically during admission and again during proxy/accounting when parallel requests finish — possible double-deduct if the accounting callback races with admission window. I'm going to pull admission logs. Can you reproduce with a small load test? Use this curl loop to emulate parallel clients:
```
for i in {1..250}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/complete \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZENITH_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"input":"hello","max_tokens":64}' &
done; wait
```

support_julie: Repro note added. Customer willing to coordinate a window. Meanwhile, recommended temporary mitigations?

eng_runtime: Quick mitigation options:
- Increase burst_credits (temporary) for zenith-prod-us to absorb immediate spikes.
- Increase headroom or reduce min_replicas cooldown to let autoscale respond faster.
- Enable model fallback (lower-cost variant) for a period to reduce per-token pressure.
- Short-term traffic shaping on client side (smoothing fanout) — ask customer to stagger clients by ~200ms.

customer_ops: They want least-impact changes first: can we bump credits and reduce cooldown? Also they asked if auth/keys could cause extra latency that affects admission timing.

sre_cheng: Auth adds ~5–20ms normally, not enough to explain credit drain. Root cause looks like admission accounting race when parallel admission checks overlap while autoscaler is warming replicas. I've already opened a trace and found several admission success logs that still result in a later ``accounting: debit_credits`` with missing idempotency token. Proposed short-term patch: make credit debits idempotent by tracking admission_nonce per request. Longer-term fix: serialize admission decrement per-client-window or use compare-and-swap on credit ledger.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-1105-zenith-burst. Priority P2. Notifying oncall rotation.

support_julie: Action items — (1) SRE: increase burst_credits to 20000 for zenith-prod-us and set autoscale_cooldown=10s, (2) Customer ops: ask customer to schedule a controlled repro window with reduced fanout for 15m, (3) Eng runtime: prioritize idempotency patch and add a canary rollout.

eng_runtime: Agree. I'll open a PR for idempotent debit logic + test harness to reproduce the race. Quick config change deployed to console in 2min (bump credits + cooldown). Will monitor.

customer_ops: They confirmed acceptance of temp config bump and will hold repro until confirm. Thanks all.

sre_cheng: Follow-up: collect these metrics for the window — admission.success, admission.reject, credit.ledger.delta, autoscale.scale_up_events, replica_warm_time. Share graphs. Suspect we should also alert when credits drop >50% within <1s.

support_julie: Noted. I'll coordinate post-mortem after repro and PR. :thumbsup:
